Sugarcane price increased by ₹30 per quintal in UP's SAP for 2025-26, pressuring margins.
Ethanol blending reached 20% as on 31 March 2026, supporting structural demand.

operating_notes.text: Total rated bank loan facilities affirmed at ₹1,817.89 Cr (reduced from ₹1,837.27 Cr), comprising ₹597.89 Cr long-term and ₹1,220.00 Cr short-term facilities.
Total sugarcane crushing capacity stands at 34,800 TCD and distillery capacity at 325 KLPD.
Sugar sales volume increased by 10% YoQ to 36.70 lac qtls in Q1FY27
Ethanol production stood at 22.1 lac litres in Q1FY27, primarily from B-molasses
Power production was 21.30 lac units in Q1FY27, with 17.30 lac units sold to the grid

timeline.summary: India Ratings reaffirmed credit ratings for Avadh Sugar's ₹1,817.89 Cr bank facilities at IND A+/Stable and IND A1.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹670.61 Cr (-1.2% YoY), net profit ₹55.61 Cr (-22.4% YoY).
Avadh Sugar released its Q4 & FY26 investor presentation highlighting higher sugarcane SAP impacts and operational performance.
Avadh Sugar & Energy Limited reported Q1FY27 results with a turnaround to profitability, driven by improved sugar realisations and higher sales volume.
